translations.web: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.
translations.bsb: So here we are today as slaves in the land You gave our fathers to enjoy its fruit and goodness— here we are as slaves!
